content.headline: Build Websites with Just JSON
content.subhead: A minimal, LLM-friendly framework for rendering static sites. Zero build step. Pure HTML + JS. Perfect for AI agents.

content.title: Core Features
content.subtitle: Everything you need in one framework

resources.title: LLM-Optimized
resources.description: Designed for AI agents to modify. Edit only site.json—never touch HTML, CSS, or JS.

resources.title: Zero Build Tools
resources.description: No npm, webpack, or complicated setup. Just open index.html in your browser.

resources.title: Reactive State
resources.description: Deep reactive state management with watchers, actions, and automatic re-rendering.

resources.title: Expression Engine
resources.description: Safe expression evaluation with double curly brace syntax. Arithmetic, comparisons, ternary operators.

resources.title: Conditional Rendering
resources.description: Show/hide blocks with if/then/else logic. Perfect for auth, empty states, and more.

resources.title: Loop Rendering
resources.description: Iterate over arrays with {{each}}. Loop metadata (index, first, last, length).

resources.title: Data Fetching
resources.description: Fetch from REST APIs with caching, transforms, and batch requests.

resources.title: Action Chains
resources.description: Execute action workflows (setState, fetch, navigate). Complete workflows with one call.

resources.title: Composable JSON
resources.description: Split large sites into page files with $import. Lazy loading with HTTP caching for optimal performance.

content.title: Quick Start
content.description: Create index.html and you're ready to go

content.content:
## Theme Customization

### PicoCSS Color Themes

DeclarativeWeb includes built-in support for **18 PicoCSS color themes**. Change themes using reactive state:

```javascript
Render.state.colorTheme = 'purple'  // Instant theme change!
```

Available themes: `default`, `red`, `pink`, `fuchsia`, `purple`, `violet`, `indigo`, `blue`, `cyan`, `jade`, `green`, `lime`, `yellow`, `amber`, `pumpkin`, `orange`, `zinc`, `slate`

### Custom Theme Settings (Advanced)

For deeper customization, define theme settings in `site.json`:

```json
"theme": {
  "fontSize": 100,
  "primaryColor": "#3b82f6",
  "secondaryColor": "#8b5cf6",
  "fontFamily": "Inter, sans-serif"
}
```

- **Font Size**: Scale from 50% to 200%
- **Primary/Secondary Colors**: Custom brand colors (hex values)
- **Font Family**: Google Fonts or custom web fonts

Changes apply instantly across the entire site!
